name: Gemini
description: Your Google AI plan's Gemini limits: how much of the Gemini app's 5-hour window and week is used, and when each resets. Read from the app's Usage limits page in the agents' browser, with its Google sign-in, once you allow it; nothing saved.
author: Vaultite

account.label: Read usage from your Google account
account.description: the Gemini app's Usage limits page (gemini.google.com/usage) is opened in the background in the agents' browser, with its Google sign-in, at most every 10 minutes while a page shows the limits, then closed; nothing is kept. Off until you allow it

container.label: Browser container
container.description: the agents' browser container signed in to the Google account with the plan, by its id (vau browser sites lists them)
